1.explanation: The core of the issue lives in ReportRenderer._renderCategory. After separating passed and non-passed audits, the method unconditionally creates a <details> element and summary for passed audits (using passedAudits.length), even when that length is zero. This results in an empty dropdown labeled “View 0 passed items.” To fix the bug, the code in _renderCategory should wrap the creation and appending of the passed-audits <details> element in a check (e.g. only if passedAudits.length > 0).
1.bug_scenario: In the Lighthouse v2 HTML report, even when there are zero passing audits in a category, the UI still renders a “View 0 passed items” <details> dropdown at the bottom of that category. The screenshot shows an empty dropdown labelled “View 0 passed items” that should not appear if there are no passed audits.

2.explanation: The ReportRenderer._renderCategory method always creates and appends a <details> block for passed audits, regardless of how many passed audits there are. When passedAudits.length is zero, the code still generates a summary reading “View 0 passed items.” To fix the bug, the code in _renderCategory should only create and append the passedElem <details> element when passedAudits.length > 0.
2.bug_scenario: In the screenshot of the Lighthouse v2 report renderer, each category shows a “View 0 passed items” dropdown at the bottom even when there are no passing audits. The category has only failing items, yet the details <details> element and its summary still appear with “View 0 passed items.”
